Duckhorn Vineyards

Three Palms Vineyard Merlot

RedAVA Napa Valley

Single-vineyard Merlot from Three Palms, in the north of Napa Valley near Calistoga, on stony soils of volcanic origin.

The Three Palms vineyard lies on the valley floor in northern Napa, between St. Helena and Calistoga. Its soils are covered with volcanic stones washed down from the nearby slopes, which drain water well and store the day’s heat. It is one of the warmest parts of the valley, which favours full ripening of Merlot.

From this vineyard Duckhorn makes one of its best-known wines, a single-vineyard Merlot that may be completed with small proportions of other Bordeaux varieties grown on the same property. It is aged in French oak barrels, with a significant share of new wood. Compared with the house’s Napa Valley Merlot, Three Palms shows greater concentration, more tannic structure and higher ageing potential, without losing the smooth texture characteristic of the variety.

Tasting profile

Deep cherry red. Aromas of ripe plum, blackberry, liquorice and spice over a background of toasted oak. Concentrated and velvety on the palate, with firm tannins and a long finish.

Food pairing

Roast duck, pork tenderloin, lamb, pasta with ragù, mushrooms

Serving

17-18 °C, decanted, large glass
